title: Spherical cavity, radius 10 mm, with a concentric ceramic sphere (εr = 4) of radius 4 mm: the TM11 triplet
source: Two-layer spherical cavity: spherical Bessel functions j₁ in the core and a combination of j₁ and y₁ in the shell, the tangential fields continuous at the interface and the tangential E zero at the wall (R. F. Harrington, Time-Harmonic Electromagnetic Fields, 1961, §6.10, extended to two layers); the roots computed by emcraft-theory (bessel::layered_sphere_resonances)

quantities.quantity: TM11 resonance, first of the triplet (GHz)
quantities.reason: two regions meshed apart with 3 mm tetrahedra and joined node for node, the wall and the interface curved (quadratic tetrahedra): −1.3e-4 (flat facets would give about +1 %)
